## Type of Change / 变更类型

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) / Bug 修复
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality) / 新功能
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected) / 破坏性变更
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update / 文档更新
- [ ] 🎨 Style update / 样式更新
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactoring / 代码重构
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / 性能优化
- [ ] ✅ Test addition/update / 测试添加/更新
- [ ] 🔧 Chore (build, CI, dependencies, etc.) / 杂项

## Description / 描述

A clear and concise description of your changes.
清晰简洁地描述你的变更。

## Related Issue / 相关 Issue

Fixes #(issue number)

## Changes Made / 变更内容

List the changes you made:
列出你做的变更：

- Change 1
- Change 2
- Change 3

## Testing / 测试

Describe how you tested your changes:
描述你如何测试你的变更：

- [ ] Local testing passed / 本地测试通过
- [ ] Multi-language testing passed (Chinese/English) / 多语言测试通过（中英文）
- [ ] Build testing passed / 构建测试通过
- [ ] Preview testing passed / 预览测试通过

### Test Environment / 测试环境

- OS: [e.g. Windows 10]
- Node.js: [e.g. 16.14.0]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 90]

## Screenshots / 截图

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your changes.
如果适用，添加截图帮助解释你的变更。

### Before / 之前

[Screenshot here]

### After / 之后

[Screenshot here]

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] ✅ Code follows the project's code standards / 代码遵循项目的代码规范
- [ ] ✅ Self-review completed / 已进行自我审查
- [ ] ✅ Comments added for hard-to-understand code / 已为难以理解的代码添加注释
- [ ] ✅ Documentation updated / 文档已更新
- [ ] ✅ No new warnings introduced / 没有引入新的警告
- [ ] ✅ Tests added to prove fix is effective or feature works / 添加了证明修复有效或功能工作的测试
- [ ] ✅ New and existing unit tests pass / 新的和现有的单元测试通过

## Additional Notes / 其他说明

Add any other notes for the reviewers.
添加任何其他给审查者的说明。
